body:
# CoarWeave
CoarWeave is a high-performance Fabric modpack designed to maximize FPS, reduce lag, and deliver smooth, stable gameplay for low-end and mid-range systems. Every included mod is carefully selected to optimize rendering, memory, and CPU usage, giving you the ultimate Minecraft experience without unnecessary bloat.

## ⚡ Key Features

Significant FPS boost

Reduced lag spikes and stuttering

Faster chunk loading

Lower RAM and CPU usage
